business_problem: Silver Egg Technology needed to hire qualified candidates faster, but limited HR capacity and slow resume screening risked losing strong applicants and reducing hiring quality.
solution_summary: Silver Egg Technology partnered with IBM Client Engineering to test a generative-AI recruiting workflow built on IBM watsonx.ai. IBM received sample resumes and job descriptions, then used watsonx.ai large language models to evaluate curriculum vitae against role requirements and flag high-potential applicants. Instead of depending on manual screening by a small HR team, the company used the model output to accelerate interview and offer decisions for strong candidates. The implementation was intentionally lightweight: it started as a proof of concept completed in under a week, focused on evaluating fairness, speed and fit before broader rollout. By treating resume screening as an AI-assisted classification and ranking problem, Silver Egg created a repeatable front-end hiring process that can shorten time to offer while preserving recruiter oversight.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.ai
solution_components.role: Analyzes resumes and job descriptions with large language models to identify high-potential candidates more quickly.

data_flow: Recruiter resumes and job descriptions are fed into watsonx.ai, the model scores or flags strong-fit applicants, and recruiting staff use those outputs to trigger interviews and faster offer decisions.
business_outcome: The proof of concept showed that Silver Egg can use generative AI to compress recruiting lead times, improve candidate responsiveness and support better hiring decisions without waiting on large HR teams to screen every application manually.
metrics: reduce the time from receipt of a resume to offer by as much as 75%
